Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Md Naushaduzzoha  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Shaheen Begum  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE NAWNEET KUMAR  PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 4 04-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the informant.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connect with Complaint Case No. 396 of 2024, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/34 of Indian Penal Code.
3. As per allegation, the petitioner and his family members demanded Rs. 10 lakhs as dowry.
On non-fulfillment of demand of dowry, the petitioner and his family members started abusing and assaulting the complainant.
4. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
The petitioner never tortured and harassed the complainant Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.32057 of 2025(4) dt.04-11-2025 nor demanded any dowry or cash from the complainant or her parents.
The petitioner is a compounder with a private doctor at Araria.
Learned counsel has further submitted that the petitioner is ready to pay Rs. 5,000/- per month as interim maintenance to opposite party no. 2.

sentences.text:
Considering the above-mentioned facts and circumstances, especially the fact that the petitioner is ready to pay Rs. 5,000/- per month as interim maintenance to opposite party no. 2, let the petitioner above named, in the event of his arrest or surrender within four weeks before the learned court below, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned S.D.J.M,
Araria in connection with Complaint Case No. 396 of 2024, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the CrPC/482(2) of the BNSS, 2023.
6.
The petitioner is directed to pay Rs. 5,000/- per month from today as interim maintenance to opposite party no. 2 (the informant).

The interim maintenance granted by this Court shall be subject to adjustment, if any other court grants maintenance to the opposite party no. 2.
7.

It is made clear that if the petitioner fails to pay Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.32057 of 2025(4) dt.04-11-2025 two continuous installments, his bail bond shall stand cancelled.
(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) amitkr/-
